title: add RAG agent templates, tool-calling examples, and docs quickstarts
author: Aarav Patel
description: This PR adds a first-pass set of RAG agent templates, multiple agent tool-calling examples (including a GitHub-issue triage bot and a knowledge-base Q&A agent), and corresponding quickstart pages on the docs site. Motivation: provide reproducible examples and low-friction quickstarts so engineers can build Retrieval-Augmented Generation agents and tool-calling flows against Redwood with minimal setup. Includes: 1) RAG templates for FAQ, conversational QA, and retrieval + chain-of-thought prompt scaffolds; 2) Agent examples that demonstrate tool-calling (HTTP tools + GitHub API + simple search), kv-prefix caching hints, and structured JSON output; 3) Docs site quickstarts with step-by-step setup, required env vars, and screenshots. Checklist: - [x] Add examples under redwood-examples/agents - [x] Add docs quickstarts and snippets to website - [x] Add templates in redwood-model-registry/templates - [x] Add tests for example scripts (smoke) - [x] Run docs-site build and link check Notes: kept templates minimal and annotated for readability; examples intentionally avoid secrets and use mock/stub wrappers for external APIs in the smoke tests. Deployment: docs site changes are static and safe to merge; examples are additive. See linked Linear tasks for rollout and follow-up tasks for expanded test coverage.
